summary: Garrett Motion Inc. filed a Form 8-K disclosing a material amendment to its credit agreement (Amendment No. 2). The amendment reduces the applicable interest rate on its USD term loan facility to 1.75% for Term Benchmark Loans and 0.75% for ABR Loans, and resets a 1.00% soft call protection for repricing transactions for six months. No specific dollar amounts, stake, merger, or acquisition terms are provided. This is a routine financing transaction, not a special situation. The disclosure also includes an investor day presentation. No board recommendation, termination fees, or change-of-control provisions are mentioned. This filing is a routine debt repricing, not a special situation.
